description_en: Queries nodes by exact match based on output
description_zh: 调用SearchNodesByOutput，根据输出精确查询节点
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public search-nodes-by-output --project-env PROD --outputs aaaaa.1231412_out,bbbb.12313123_out --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchNodesByOutput

parameters.help_en:
The environment identifier in Operation Center. Valid values:

PROD: production environment.
DEV: development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心环境标识：PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The output strings of the node. You can specify multiple values. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点的输出串。支持多个值，多个值时请使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: outputs
